trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: State the intent to reschedule an appointment and provide patient ID.
steps.text: नमस्ते। मेरा कल का appointment है, PT-1005. मुझे इसको change करना है, कल मैं नहीं आ पाऊँगा।

steps.purpose: Look up patient record to verify registration and open appointments.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_patient_record to retrieve patient details using the provided ID.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided a patient ID, so the agent must look up the record to verify registration and open appointments.

steps.purpose: Return patient record details.
Acknowledge the record and ask for verification factors.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। आपका record check करने के लिए, क्या आप अपना registered name और date of birth बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide verification factors and seek confirmation.
steps.text: मेरा नाम सुरेश है और date of birth 12 May 1980 है। क्या यह details काफी हैं आगे बढ़ने के लिए?

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using the provided factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the provided name and DOB.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided verification factors, which must be validated before modifying the appointment.

steps.purpose: Return verification outcome.
Confirm verification and ask for the preferred reschedule date.
steps.text: हाँ सुरेश जी, आपकी details verify हो गई हैं। आपका ENT department में appointment है। आप इसे किस दिन के लिए reschedule करना चाहते हैं?

steps.purpose: Request a new date and ask for clarification on the department term.
steps.text: मुझे परसों का time दे दो। और यह ENT क्या होता है? कान और गले का doctor ना? मुझे ठीक से समझ नहीं आता।
steps.clean_text: मुझे परसों का time दे दो। और यह ENT क्या होता है? कान और गले का doctor ना? मुझे ठीक से समझ नहीं आता।
steps.model_visible_text: मुझे बरसों का time दे दो। और यह ENT क्या होता है? कान और गले का doctor ना? मुझे ठीक से समझ नहीं आता।

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for the requested timeframe.
steps.expected_behavior: Select check_doctor_availability instead of book_appointment to find a suitable slot first.
steps.planner_rationale: The user requested a new time, so the agent must check availability before booking.

steps.purpose: Return available slots for the short window.
Explain the department term and offer the available slot.
steps.text: जी, ENT मतलब कान, नाक और गले का department होता है। परसों यानी Wednesday के लिए Dr. Sharma के पास सुबह 10:00 AM का slot है। इसकी consultation fee 500 रुपये है। क्या मैं इसे confirm कर दूँ?

steps.purpose: Reject the offered slot and request a later date.
steps.text: सुबह 10 बजे तो मैं busy रहूँगा। क्या अगले हफ्ते Monday का कोई time मिल सकता है? मैं आराम से आना चाहता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for a longer timeframe.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_doctor_availability again with a longer window to find a Monday slot.
steps.planner_rationale: The user rejected the 3-day window slot and asked for next week, requiring a new availability check.

steps.purpose: Return available slots for the longer window.
Offer the newly found slot.
steps.text: मैं check करती हूँ। अगले हफ्ते Monday को Dr. Verma के पास दोपहर 02:00 PM का slot available है। इसकी fee 600 रुपये है। क्या यह time आपके लिए ठीक रहेगा?

steps.purpose: Confirm the time and ask for reassurance about fees.
steps.text: दोपहर 2 बजे ठीक है। तो fee 600 रुपये होगी ना? एक बार confirm कर लीजिए, मुझे बाद में कोई extra charge तो नहीं देना पड़ेगा? मैं यह सब online payment नहीं समझता।

steps.purpose: Reassure the user about the fee and confirm readiness to book.
steps.text: हाँ सुरेश जी, slot की fee 600 रुपये ही है, आपको कोई extra charge नहीं देना होगा। Payment आप hospital आकर भी कर सकते हैं। क्या मैं यह slot book कर दूँ?

steps.purpose: Give final consent to book the slot.
steps.text: हाँ, 600 रुपये और Monday 2 बजे। ठीक है, आप इसको book कर दीजिये।

steps.purpose: Book the confirmed appointment slot.
steps.expected_behavior: Call book_appointment with the agreed slot ID.
steps.planner_rationale: The user explicitly agreed to the slot and fee, so the agent can execute the consequential action.

steps.purpose: Return booking confirmation details.
Provide the booking reference and final confirmation.
steps.text: आपका appointment reschedule हो गया है। आपका booking reference B-9921 है। Monday को दोपहर 02:00 PM बजे Dr. Verma के साथ आपकी appointment confirm हो गई है।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the booking and end the conversation.
steps.text: Booking reference B-9921 है, Monday 2 बजे। मैंने लिख लिया है। बस यही काम था।

ir.terminal_condition: Appointment confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time and fee.
